components.item.bgeM3.title: Embedding model bge-m3
components.item.bgeM3.summary: Lets memory find materials by meaning (quantized, runs on the CPU). Without it, materials are still saved and keyword search still works.
components.item.asr.title: Speech recognition model Fun-ASR Nano
components.item.asr.summary: Turns hold-to-talk voice into text (runs on this computer, downloaded from upstream rather than bundled; no Python needed).
components.item.asr.licenseSummary: Free to use, modify and share if you credit the source and authors and keep the model name. The text says it is for reference and learning only, with no warranty, and has no separate commercial clause: judge commercial use yourself
components.item.audiocpp.title: Speech program audio.cpp
components.item.audiocpp.summary: The local service voice replies and speech recognition run on (the open-source audio.cpp). The models are separate components; installing a model installs this first.
components.item.tts.title: Speech model Fish S2 Pro
components.item.tts.licenseSummary: Free for personal, non-commercial use; commercial use needs separate authorization from Fish Audio
components.item.tts.summary: Lets ergo answer your voice messages by voice (the model runs on this computer and is downloaded from upstream; ergo does not bundle it).
components.item.claudeCode.title: Claude Code integration
components.item.claudeCode.summary: Lets tasks and projects be handed to Claude Code (the official SDK, downloaded from the official npm registry).
components.item.codex.title: Codex integration
components.item.codex.summary: Lets tasks and projects be handed to Codex (OpenAI's open-source command-line program, downloaded from the official npm registry; it signs in with your own Codex account, and ergo never touches that).
